FlowState Documentation
=======================

.. image:: https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-blue.svg
   :alt: Version
.. image:: https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.14+-green.svg
   :alt: Python Version
.. image:: https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg
   :alt: License

Welcome to FlowState's documentation! FlowState is a cutting-edge Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) application
designed to optimize flow states through real-time EEG neurofeedback using Muse headbands.

Key Features
------------

* **Real-time EEG Processing**: Process brain signals at 256Hz from Muse headbands via LSL protocol
* **Flow State Detection**: Advanced algorithms using power spectral density analysis to identify flow states
* **Binaural Beat Generation**: Dynamic audio feedback for brainwave entrainment (Alpha, Theta, Gamma)
* **Multi-modal Feedback**: Coordinated audio, visual, and haptic feedback systems
* **AI-Driven Optimization**: Machine learning models for personalized flow enhancement
* **Cross-platform Support**: Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux
